name: personUrl
label: Person URL
help: Public or hashed LinkedIn URL of the person whose skill you want to endorse. LinkedIn lets you endorse skills only of your 1st-degree connections.

name: skillName
label: Skill Name
help: Name of the skill to endorse, up to 200 characters. It must equal the skill's name on the person's profile; letter case and extra spaces are ignored. It is not a pattern. Skill names are shown as the profile owner entered them, in the owner's language, whatever your own LinkedIn language: a German profile lists Projektmanagement, not Project Management. A skill you have already endorsed is left as it is and counts as a success. Every successful endorsement counts toward the stEndorsements limit.
